methodology: Registered 2026 original candidate PDFs, districts and polling-station PDFs were downloaded directly, read and reconciled against the literal regression roster. The live polling PDF assigns Jána Hollého to station 4, not cached station 14.

Three disjoint candidate cohorts researched all eight categories. Each receipt records actual queries, opened originals, supporting sources, identity attributes, exclusions and access limits. Search snippets were discovery only.

Found ballot occupations are bounded to the official 2026 candidate list; they do not establish current employment. Current offices use live official bodies; dated election results alone do not establish uninterrupted service.
Business joins require personal municipality/year or a direct institutional/declaration bridge. Company registered offices alone were not accepted as personal residence evidence.

Reports, responses and procedural records remain separate. searched_none denotes no usable evidence found within the documented public search, not nonexistence. Raw captures and private identity details are excluded from this repository.

Finance registry was checked for all 52 new exact candidate names. Candidate-owned account links or published IBANs plus municipality and 2026 mayor context verify three accounts. Name-only matches remain unverified; absence from the checked registry alone is not absence of an account.

Existing candidate, claim, coverage and source records are retained unchanged. Shared chair evidence retains actual earlier verification dates; the 2026 official Dolný Kubín chair PDF was separately reconciled.
